description: Morphology-neutral analysis-by-synthesis over factorized opaque effectors. The graph constructs arbitrary-width simultaneous programs, sends the exact program through shared motor collapse, and learns six-axis consequences conditioned on body-relative vector flow and delayed power state from receipts. Specification-grounded structural limits exclude unsafe primitive calibration and compound programs before release. Flown programs are indexed BY TYPE AND SHAPE in an EmbodiedMotorProgramShape codebook (one relation per member: actuator group as predicate, integer command ordinal as coordinate), grown and collapsed behind the action and re-armed by motor_codebook_epoch. Optional graph-native temporal command encoding carries quantisation residuals per opaque effector group and is disabled unless explicitly enabled.

rules.name: emp_share_group_context_transition_evidence
rules.comment: A cold command-level model may use averaged same-group transition evidence from ordinary receipts; an unevidenced group remains unsupported.

rules.name: emp_signature_internalized_program
rules.comment: A motor program's SHAPE is one relation per member, predicate = actuator group (the type), argument = integer command ordinal. Stamped behind the action on a program that has already flown, so the hard-realtime composer is untouched.

rules.name: emp_grow_motor_program_shape
rules.comment: Mint the flown program as a codebook entry indexed by type and shape, and bump the motor codebook epoch.

rules.name: emp_index_surprise_shape
rules.comment: Mint the quantised residual as a surprise shape, carrying the response it produced, the first time that shape is seen.

rules.name: emp_count_stable_surprise_response
rules.comment: A held surprise shape produced the same response again: extend its stable run by one encounter.

rules.name: emp_vary_surprise_response
rules.comment: A held surprise shape produced a different response: record the new response and restart the stable run.

rules.name: emp_condense_surprise_reflex
rules.comment: A surprise shape whose response has not varied over N encounters condenses to order 0.

rules.name: emp_release_condensed_reflex
rules.comment: A condensed reflex whose response has started varying is released back to order 1.

rules.name: emp_fork_regime_local_model
rules.comment: A residual in a regime this model has never seen forks it: the fork inherits the parent's means and restarts its own count.

rules.name: emp_arm_condensed_reflex
rules.comment: A condensed surprise shape recurred this action: arm the order-0 reflex.

rules.name: emp_enact_motor_reflex_buy_time
rules.comment: A fired order-0 reflex is enacted and disarmed by a rule reading the engine's own firing stamp.
